composites.name: mosaic_dfba_ecoli_core
composites.description: Dynamic-FBA metabolic-arm template: Michaelis-Menten uptake constraining COBRApy FBA on the E. coli core GEM (diauxic glucose -> acetate overflow). The reusable MOSAIC metabolic-module pattern — swap in a tissue/microbe GEM.

composites.name: mosaic_dfba_lactobacillus
composites.description: Dynamic-FBA of a lactic-acid bacterium (L. lactis iNF517) as a vaginal-microbiome metabolic proxy for Aim 1 (Lactobacillus-dominant, lactate-producing states): Michaelis-Menten uptake constraining COBRApy FBA on glucose + glutamate.

composites.name: mosaic_dfba_coculture
composites.description: Process-bigraph COMPOSITION: two dynamic-FBA organisms (E. coli core + Lactobacillus iNF517) sharing one substrate pool and competing for glucose. Each model runs standalone in its own study; here they are coupled through a shared `substrates` store (FBA writes consumption deltas, so competition composes additively — no custom coupling process).
